views.observation: Cell family, quiet/dividing activity and clinical receptor/RNA classifications answer different questions. Neither cartoon shape nor receptor icons establish a malignant lineage or actual classifier result. Geometry is redrawn between themes.

views.observation: Whole light image separately viewed. Epithelial family, quiet/dividing state and receptor/RNA classification are compatible but distinct. Heatmap and symbols are schematic, without patient results.

views.observation: A/B 1+1, A/absent 1+0, A/A 2+0 and A/A/B 2+1 are internally consistent locus-copy examples. Copy-neutral LOH preserves total two while removing heterozygosity. Copy count does not establish gene function.

views.observation: Whole light copy diagram separately viewed; labels and copy totals match the dark examples. Shape, count and colours do not identify a patient genotype, tumour fraction or functional status.

views.observation: Normal breast duct shows lumen, luminal layer, outer myoepithelial layer, basement membrane and surrounding stromal cell types; biopsy mixes cancer, normal epithelial, immune, fibroblast and endothelial contributors. Footer must mean normal epithelial cells also exist, not that all normal cells are epithelial. Right fibroblast is drawn without a label.

views.observation: Whole light duct/mixture separately viewed. The left orange fibroblast has an unlabeled leader; the right fibroblast is labelled. Schematic tissue proportions do not quantify purity. Footer wording needs epithelial scope.

views.method: view_image original-detail whole native PNG, 1536x1024, no crop or generated render
views.observation: Immune cells nearby, peptide-HLA-I display and TCR-dependent response are separate evidence questions. Recognition and response are not automatic killing or benefit. Counts and receptor geometry are schematic.

views.method: view_image original-detail whole native PNG, 1536x1024, no crop or generated render
views.observation: Whole light immune sequence separately viewed. Question mark leaves recognition open. Colour and nearby immune presence do not establish natural peptide display or specificity. This is a redraw, not exact-pixel recolouring.

views.method: view_image original-detail whole native PNG, 1536x1024, no crop or generated render
views.observation: Repeated reads grouped in a UMI/barcode context illustrate one captured molecule, not a complete RNA census. Ambient RNA can enter a partition. Two nuclei can share a partition barcode. UMI tags are generic labels, not actual sequence data proving deduplication.

views.method: view_image original-detail whole native PNG, 1536x1024, no crop or generated render
views.observation: Whole light RNA-counting image separately viewed. Three repeated reads to one molecule is conditional on valid grouping; capture/errors/collisions are not measured. RNA counts do not directly measure intact protein or activity.

views.method: view_image original-detail whole native PNG, 1536x1024, no crop or generated render
views.observation: Surface-target candidate separates RNA detection, protein production, surface location and controlled functional perturbation. Question marks do not certify an effect. Decorative completed checklist is not validation of these samples.

views.method: view_image original-detail whole native PNG, 1536x1024, no crop or generated render
views.observation: Whole light surface-target image separately viewed. Control/perturbation colours and dish-cell counts are illustrative, not measured treatment effect. The four questions do not mandate every assay for every established biomarker.

views.method: view_image original-detail whole native PNG, 1536x1024, no crop or generated render
views.observation: Splicing joins exons1,2,3; skipping exon2 yields1,3 RNA. RNA processing is distinct from deleting genomic DNA. Omitted exon/intron pieces are schematic, not a literal lariat mechanism. Detectable transcript does not prove intact protein.

views.method: view_image original-detail whole native PNG, 1536x1024, no crop or generated render
views.observation: Whole light splice diagram separately viewed. Normal versus skipped example does not imply all exon skipping is pathological; no exon lengths/coding frame/protein outcome can be inferred from these blocks.

DNA recipe, RNA message, protein tool and unchecked made/location/working questions read in full. Light has unoriented decorative base-letter lines; neither image supplies a validated complete sequence, coding frame or measured protein. Dark is a material redraw, not exact-pixel preservation.
